mapping: UnknownActorRef maps to IActor; Snapshot.status maps to SnapshotStatus. A status enum cannot be compared with an arbitrary string.
ActorRefFromLogic<IActorLogic<TSnapshot>> maps to IActorRef<TSnapshot>; Actor<TSnapshot> must be assignable for any valid TSnapshot.
Graph serializeEvent accepts a C# delegate returning ordinary string; no branded string is required. The machine and traversal call are compiled together.
Graph serializeState accepts a C# delegate returning ordinary string; no branded string is required. The machine and traversal call are compiled together.
MachineSnapshot<TContext> and StateMapper<TContext,TResult> share the context type. Lambda parameters expose Count as int and Name as string; the resulting tuple retains both types.
The same TResult int is required at root, child and grandchild mappers. The complete nested mapping and machine snapshot compile together.
MapState returns StateMapResult<TContext,int>; Result is assignable to int and is not assignable to string.
